method.mismatch: ETF Price Score vs existing equal-weight constituent Internal Score
method.concentration: current ETF holding weights; WEIGHT_READY requires >=70% member weight coverage and >=60% reported weight sum
method.movement_concentration: share of absolute normalized weighted constituent move attributable to the five highest-weight constituents
method.early_motion: 5D and 10D constituent positive-return breadth and median return, shown separately from 20D confirmation
method.large_cap_note: High ETF weight is a more direct ETF-price influence measure than company market cap. Labels therefore say 上位構成銘柄主導 rather than asserting market-cap class when market-cap data is not used.
